exposure: early provision of mother's own milk (MOM)
outcome: breast milk feeding (BMF) between 36 and 40 weeks postmenstrual age (PMA)
exclusive, partial, or no BMF at 36 weeks PMA
cohort: The study included 138 singleton infants born at >32 weeks of gestation in Stockholm, Sweden.
finding: High intake of mother's own milk early in the postnatal period was strongly related to exclusive breast milk feeding at 36 weeks postmenstrual age.
followup_time: Observations were taken up to 40 weeks postmenstrual age.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken at postnatal day 7 for early MOM, and at 36 and 40 weeks postmenstrual age for BMF.
